3rdParty/

Boost
https://sourceforge.net/projects/boost/files/boost-binaries/
boost_1_60_0-msvc-14.0-64.exe

curl 7.48 (http://curl.haxx.se/download.html "Win32 - MSVC" to build from source)
cd winbuild
set RTLIBCFG=static
nmake /f Makefile.vc mode=static VC=14 MACHINE=x64 DEBUG=no
nmake /f Makefile.vc mode=static VC=14 MACHINE=x64 DEBUG=yes

libs/x64 (drop various .lib files in here)

OpenEXR (http://www.openexr.com/)
cmake -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="../build" -G "Visual Studio 14 2015 Win64" ..\ilmbase-2.2.0
msbuild ilmbase.sln /t:Build /p:Configuration=Release /p:Platform=x64
cmake -DZLIB_ROOT="../zlib/" -DILMBASE_PACKAGE_PREFIX="../build" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="../build" -G "Visual Studio 14 2015 Win64" ../openexr-2.2.0
(basically use the instructions provided in openexr source package)

png/lpng162 (http://sourceforge.net/projects/libpng/files/libpng16/older-releases/)
png/zlib-1.2.5 (http://sourceforge.net/projects/libpng/files/zlib/1.2.5/)

Python (need include files here, libs in libs)

Tiff (http://download.osgeo.org/libtiff/  v4.0.6)

nmake -f win32/Makefile.msc AS=ml64 LOC="-DASMV -DASMINF -I." OBJA="inffasx64.obj gvmat64.obj inffas8664.obj"
